newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Jasa Marga picks advisors for listing.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Jasa Marga picks advisors for listing.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned toll road operator PT Jasa Marga has appointed legal, accounting and listing advisors ahead of its planned listing locally and overseas in 1997, the Media Indonesia daily reported on Tuesday.

Media said Jasa Marga has appointed Hadiputranto, Hadinoto & Partners as legal advisor and Hans Tuana Kotta & Mustoffa as accounting advisor for the listing. Both consultancy firms are privately-owned local firms.
The newspaper said Jasa Marga had also appointed joint-venture firm PT BZW-Niaga Sekuritas as listing advisor.
"The listing is most likely to take place in 1997," Media quoted Jasa Marga president-director Maryadi Darmokumoro as saying, adding that the firm had taken years to prepare for it.
The newspaper gave no further details. Jasa Marga and the three advisors were not immediately available for comment.

Darmokumuro was quoted as saying Jasa Marga expected to post a net profit of 238.98 billion rupiah in 1996 against 266.17 billion rupiah in 1995. It was expected to post a net profit of 282 billion rupiah in 1997, he said.

Indonesian state-controlled telecommunications firms PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) and PT Indonesia Satellite Corp. (Indosat), and integrated tin mining firm PT Tambang Timah are listed overseas.
